text:
emma (People Ops): short 'clarity-first' checklist for goals & self-reviews. paste into kickoff, PRs, or the reviewer packet.

emma (People Ops): TL;DR: one-sentence objective, three evidence items (2 required + optional customer note), one hiring line if needed, and a 1-line validation hint.

emma (People Ops): ```Clarity-first goal card (pasteable)
Objective (1 sent): <what success looks like>
Owner: <name> | Effort: <XS/S/M/L> | Hiring ask: <role+priority+ETA or "none">
Top 3 signals (one-line each, include link/number):
  1) <metric/artifact baseline -> target> (evidence A link)
  2) <artifact / experiment result> (evidence B link)
  3) <customer quote / dashboard pane> (optional)
Validation: high/med/low (how easy for reviewer to check)
Immediate next step: <owner + date + effort: quick/medium/major>
One-sentence success criterion for product: <done = ...>
```

emma (People Ops): quick peer feedback snippet to map to the card: 
• "Concrete effect I saw: <one-line + link>"
• "Small change to increase impact: <one-line>"
• "Validation note: easy/needs-data/hard"

ryan (eng-manager): adding a check that evidence timestamps are within the cycle window. avoids stale links.

emma (People Ops): added in the handbook: "Evidence should be dated within the active cycle or include a short note explaining relevance."

nina (product): for cross-team KRs, please add the stakeholder sign-off line: `Stakeholders: <names>` so reviewers know alignment.

emma (People Ops): good call. added `Stakeholders` to the card.

omar (recruiter): if Hiring ask is filled, ops will auto-create a recruiter handoff task when you paste the card to #people-ops-resources (include link to role spec).

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Saved card & peer snippet to People Ops snippets and linked the handbook quick-copy.

ryan (eng-manager): will pilot this for my team's OKR pack tomorrow. short and usable — thanks! :thumbsup:
